Looking at the error, the issue is that when we recursively call `Prove(s[1..])`, we need to first establish that `K.Clean(s[1..])` holds (the precondition).

Since we have `K.Clean(s)` and `|s| >= 2`, we can use `O.TailInvariant(s)` to establish `K.Clean(s[1..])`.

Let me trace through the logic:
1. If `|s| < 2`, we use `O.Base(s)` 
2. If `|s| >= 2`, we need to:
   - First establish `s[0] != s[1]` using `O.Boundary(s)` (from `K.Clean(s)` and `|s| >= 2`)
   - Establish `K.Clean(s[1..])` using `O.TailInvariant(s)` (from `K.Clean(s)` and `|s| >= 2`)
   - Then recursively call `Prove(s[1..])` which gives us `K.Compress(s[1..]) == s[1..]`
   - Use `O.Keep(s)` to establish `K.Compress(s) == [s[0]] + K.Compress(s[1..])`
   - Combined: `K.Compress(s) == [s[0]] + s[1..] == s`

```json
{
  "HelperA.dfy": "if |s| < 2 {\n      O.Base(s);\n    } else {\n      O.Boundary(s);\n      O.TailInvariant(s);\n      Prove(s[1..]);\n      O.Keep(s);\n      assert s == [s[0]] + s[1..];\n    }"
}
```
